properties.name: apiKey
properties.title: API Key
properties.description: Your OpenAI API key. Test asks OpenAI which image models it may use.

properties.name: imageModel
properties.title: Image Model
properties.description: The image models your API key may use, as OpenAI lists them (DALL·E is retired). gpt-image-2 and later draw in the panel's own shape; older models draw a fixed size, shown with a blurred margin.

properties.name: quality
properties.title: Quality
properties.description: Higher costs more. A model that does not offer the level chosen uses the nearest one below it (Extra high and Maximum are gpt-image-2.5's).

properties.name: moderation
properties.title: Moderation
properties.description: How strictly OpenAI filters what it draws: auto is its standard filter, low is less strict.

properties.name: prompt
properties.title: Prompt
properties.description: Your Gen-AI prompt for the image.

properties.name: randomizePrompt
properties.title: Randomize Prompt
properties.description: Have a text model rewrite the prompt before each picture, so no two are alike.

properties.name: promptModel
properties.title: Prompt Model
properties.description: The text model that rewrites the prompt, from those your API key may use.
